problem: V68 protects generated df10 loss rows but permits editing/deleting an original zeroed charge while its loan is defaulted. That can destroy the component evidence needed by Undo Default.
behavior: Original Charges UPDATE/DELETE requires both old and new referenced loans to be nondefaulted. Undo Default first, then ordinary charge CRUD. Derived-cache-only updates remain valid and recompute authoritative values.
internal_transition: Existing nested Default/Undo may change only principal, interest, Notes and derived columns on the same keyed charge/loan, with trigger depth >=2 and exact transaction-local business_crud.default loan context. No original-charge DELETE bypass. Existing generated-loss guard is preserved.
locking: Existing V12 aa_vc_lock locks affected borrowers NOWAIT before default_posting_guard. Meaningful original-charge edits lock old/new Loans in deterministic order FOR SHARE NOWAIT and check their state under lock. Derived-only updates avoid new parent locks. A competing command can first wait on an already-held child row; tests check valid outcomes and bounded completion, not universal nonwaiting behavior.
permissions: SECURITY INVOKER remains; no grants, fields, relationship or app changes. The parent FOR SHARE lock requires the underlying loan-lock privileges for a restricted direct writer; no privilege expansion is performed.
scope_limits: INSERT into a defaulted loan is outside this proven UPDATE/DELETE repair; existing rules remain. UI should not offer new manual charges for defaulted parents.
No repair/backfill of previously altered or deleted charge evidence. Undo retains its existing reconciliation errors for unsupported prior damage.
Notes-bearing original charges and generated loss rows remain visible; correct through the owning loan's Undo Default, not child actions.
DEV apply requires an explicit coordinated window after current GUI operations reconcile. No live migration or mutation performed during candidate preparation.
